results: The EXISTING actual native resolvent is faithfully realized on EVERY source-normalized periodic physical L2 input with continuous outputs. This actual physical operator family is analytic in operator norm at every native resolvent point, and the EXISTING actual continuous Riesz projection is PROVED to be its normalized integral on the SAME native contour.

A reusable full native contour bound is proved: a uniform bound M for the ACTUAL physical resolvent difference on a source circle gives the ACTUAL physical Riesz projection difference bound radius*M. The proof commutes the existing full H1 native resolvent integral with the faithful continuous inclusion and uses its analytic native integrability; it does NOT assume analytic half-denominator or phase factors.

The ACTUAL physical resolvent is EXACTLY the source half-continuous-output map composed with the actual normalized inverse and physical L2 input half-map, through the two norm-preserving Fourier isometries. The actual zero-potential middle operator is identified with the literal free phase inverse. The exact resolvent DIFFERENCE retains the same actual half-maps and the actual normalized inverse difference.

For EVERY actual original source-circle parameter with norm(S_lambda)<=1/2, the norm of the FULL original physical L2-to-continuous resolvent difference, multiplied by the original radius n, is at most C*log(n)*n^(r-1)*norm(q)_H^-r, C=32*(8*exp(1)+2). This is proved from the actual sharp free half-output bound, actual full rough-potential S_lambda norm bound and norm-one physical Fourier isometries; no physical operator estimate is supplied as a hypothesis.

The ACTUAL original periodic contour projection minus the ACTUAL zero-potential contour projection has norm at most C*log(n)*n^(r-1)*norm(q)_H^-r, in continuous-output norm and therefore in BOTH original physical L-infinity and physical L2 operator norms. ONE cutoff BEFORE EVERY complex original H^(-r) potential in EACH FIXED original norm ball and ALL later ORIGINAL indices gives this bound and actual native circle validity, for EVERY 0<=r<1.

The one-logarithm majorant tends to zero for EVERY r<1. Genuine uniform periodic projection convergence in ALL THREE physical norms is proved on EVERY FIXED original H^(-r) norm ball, with the norm ball fixed BEFORE epsilon. No tolerance-dependent-neighborhood argument substitutes for this quantifier.

The ACTUAL original zero-potential physical resolvent has the exact Fourier coefficient (lambda-pi^2*k^2)^(-1)*F_k at EVERY signed mode. Commuting each bounded Fourier coefficient with its ACTUAL analytic native contour integral proves that the ACTUAL free projection retains EXACTLY k=+n and k=-n. The ACTUAL free contour output is PROVED to be F_n*exp(i*pi*n*x)+F_(-n)*exp(-i*pi*n*x) on EVERY physical L2 input, with no mode truncation assumption or supplied free-kernel identity.

The article adapter proves the EXACT periodic Appendix C.4(i) rate C_t*(log(n))^2/n^(1-|t|)*norm(q)_H^t throughout the ENTIRE original -1<t<-1/2 range, parameterized by t=-r and 1/2<r<1. A positive constant is chosen BEFORE EVERY original potential norm ball and BEFORE ANY supplied earlier spectral cutoff. ONE new cutoff is chosen ABOVE that supplied cutoff and before ALL original complex potentials in the ball and ALL later original positive indices. The proved stronger one-logarithm bound implies the source squared-logarithm bound.

The periodic part of source (33) is PROVED on the ENTIRE original complex endpoint space for EVERY article order -1/2<s<=0, with genuine UNIFORM convergence on EACH FIXED ORIGINAL ENDPOINT NORM BALL. A bounded original distribution inclusion into H^(-rho), rho=3/4+r_endpoint/2, transfers the quantitative periodic estimate. Equality with the IDENTICAL original H-minus-one source potential is PROVED from equality of the ENTIRE original distributions; no potential, index, physical period or norm normalization is changed.

The Dirichlet part of source (33) was already proved with its stated local/compact uniformity qualifications. The precise Dirichlet C.4(ii) RATE remains OPEN.
